claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: PNU-120596 is a selective alpha7 nAChR positive allosteric modulator with no reported cytotoxic or antiproliferative activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines.

raw.cytotoxic_mechanism: PNU-120596 is a selective alpha7 nAChR positive allosteric modulator with no reported cytotoxic or antiproliferative activity; at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive against cancer cell lines.
